description:
## Summary

- Introduce `MediaManager` abstraction that centralizes all file lifecycle operations with permission hardening (0o600 files, 0o700 directories)
- Unify duplicated screenshot/audio cleanup and orphan sweep into generic functions via `MediaTable` descriptor, with file-first deletion ordering for crash safety
- Add startup orphan sweep, path validation on file ops, and honest error logging in `Storage::status()`

## Test Plan

- [x] 143 tests passing (68 in storage crate, 143 workspace-wide)
- [x] Permission hardening verified: files get 0o600, directories get 0o700
- [x] File-first cleanup ordering tested
- [x] Orphan sweep detects and removes untracked files
- [x] `status()` handles metadata errors gracefully
- [x] Path validation rejects paths outside storage root
- [x] Clippy clean, no secrets in diff

Part of HEU-405
